name: ktuner-assistant
description: Civic FE Tune Assist: a guided AFR tuning companion for the Honda Civic FE 1.5T CVT on Vietnam E10, for KTuner and Hondata users.

scripts.dev: echo 'Serving at http://localhost:8000/ (file:// works for the built-in drives; use this server for your own CSVs)' && python3 -m http.server 8000
scripts.test: node --test test/engine.test.js test/drive.test.js test/ask.test.js test/build.test.js test/car.test.js test/thresholds.test.js
